headerDisplay: Exposes each configured [OwnTone](https://owntone.github.io/owntone-server/) server as a HomeKit Television-style media accessory. Television accessories cannot be bridged, so each server must be paired separately in the Home app using the setup code printed in the Homebridge log.
footerDisplay: Apple Home does not expose every media-player feature. Album artwork is fetched and cached internally but cannot be displayed by the Home app. See the [README](https://github.com/spacedmonkey/homebridge-owntone#readme) for the full list of limitations.

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: Name shown for this platform in the Homebridge log.

servers.title: OwnTone Servers
servers.description: Each entry becomes one HomeKit Television accessory.

name.title: Accessory Name
name.description: Name shown in the Home app, e.g. "Living Room Music".

host.title: Host
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the OwnTone server, e.g. 192.168.1.50 or owntone.local.

port.title: Port
port.description: OwnTone JSON API port. The OwnTone default is 3689.

timeout.title: Request Timeout (milliseconds)
timeout.description: Requests taking longer than this are aborted.

pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often playback state and now-playing metadata are refreshed.

enableWebSocket.title: Use Push Notifications
enableWebSocket.description: When the server supports it, subscribes to its WebSocket for near-instant updates and backs off polling to an infrequent safety-net check. Disable to always poll at the interval above instead.

pushReconnectInterval.title: Push Reconnect Interval (minutes)
pushReconnectInterval.description: How often to proactively reconnect an already-healthy push notification connection, to catch one that has silently died without disconnecting — useful since Homebridge may run for months between restarts. Only has an effect when Use Push Notifications is on and the server actually supports it.

exposeTrackSwitches.title: Expose Next/Previous/Play-Pause Switches
exposeTrackSwitches.description: Adds stateless switches for next track, previous track and play/pause. Useful for automations and when the Apple Remote mapping is not enough.

ignoreCertificateErrors.title: Ignore HTTPS Certificate Errors
ignoreCertificateErrors.description: Only applies to HTTPS. Enable when the server uses a self-signed certificate.

username.title: Username
username.description: Optional. Only needed when OwnTone sits behind a reverse proxy that requires HTTP basic authentication.

password.title: Password
password.description: Optional. Used together with the username for HTTP basic authentication.

bearerToken.title: Bearer Token
bearerToken.description: Optional. Sent as an Authorization: Bearer header. Takes precedence over username/password.

outputs.title: Known Outputs
outputs.description: Cached AirPlay/Chromecast outputs last seen on this server. Populated by the "Refresh Outputs" button above; not user-edited.
